name: Survival.io
summary:
Survival.io is a top-down real-time strategy and survival game played in the web browser. The player controls a lord who gathers wood, stone, iron, gold and food, builds a Town Center, towers, barracks, farms and a smithy, crafts tools, weapons and armor, and recruits an army of spearmen, archers, cavalry and crossbowmen that follows them into battle. Units have counter bonuses (spears against cavalry, cavalry against archers, crossbows against heavy armor), troops need food and gold as upkeep, and a kingdom is eliminated when its Town Center is destroyed.

Matches are played against AI kingdoms or other players. Modes unlock as the player's kingdom levels up: Quick Battle, Classic Conquest, a Story campaign, Deathmatch, King of the Hill, Zombie Night and custom games. The game also features fog of war, day/night cycles, guard towers garrisoned by archers, contested gold mines, a market with supply and demand pricing, daily chests, missions, a Royal Pass and cosmetic items. It is available in 17 languages.
